scope: research/ocm-morphology-zoo-v1 (issue #221 MZ-D2/MZ-D3); frozen BEFORE any MZ-D3 production run

interpretation_rules: CENSUS TRUTH IS BOUND-RELATIVE: genomes outside CENSUS_BOUND_V1 (mutations/crossovers widen the space) may exceed census best_dev; observed calibration max 0.700384.
best_dev_gap may legitimately be negative; negative gap = arm beat the census bound, never a defect.
Cell-recovery denominators are the census-OCCUPIED cells (4 S / 2 B), never the full 10x10 grid; grid coverage at this bound is near-degenerate and is reported as a finding, not a bug.

metrics_frozen.S_cell_recovery: |arm S_structural_2d occupied cells INTERSECT census S cells| / 4 (descriptors recomputed from genomes for every arm)
metrics_frozen.best_dev: max dev_score over arm archive; gap = 0.649325 - best_dev (negative allowed)
metrics_frozen.qd_score: sum of elite dev_scores within arm archive
metrics_frozen.unique_phenotypes: len(distinct phenotype digests among feasible evals)
metrics_frozen.comparisons: same-evaluation-count AND same-CPU-hour both reported (wall_s per arm recorded in every result row)

known_defects_of_metrics: S/B cell recovery saturates trivially (denominators 4 and 2); it cannot discriminate arms — retained for continuity, never cited as QD evidence alone.
pareto_recovery rewards exact phenotype matches inside the bound; arms pushing outside the bound trade it off against best_dev. Both are reported together, always.

production_MZ_D3.rationale: 0.71x census size; chosen before any production run from throughput pilot (0.086 ms/eval, worst arm lexicase 7.1 s/4000 evals; projected full campaign < 1 CPU-hour)
production_MZ_D3.amendment_rule: wider arrays / extra seeds / changed budgets = numbered freeze amendments (FREEZE_V1_AMEND_n.json), reported separately, never overwrite
